concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-orchestration-flexfactor]] - Braintree-hosted FlexFactor route through PayPal Orchestration Platform with currency-specific merchant-account and securely shared FlexFactor-credential prerequisites, merchant-triggered initial retries, integration-scoped automatic retries, and `SETTLING` fulfillment guardrails; not independent FlexFactor provider authority or proof of enablement, execution, recovery, settlement, dispute outcome, or funding
warnings: Keep this route distinct from Braintree Forward API; do not import forwarding-only limitations.
The guide is Braintree-hosted integration authority, not independent FlexFactor provider authority or proof of actual execution.
